utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I’m checking for Mina while I’m out—do you know who’s definitely bringing drills, ladders, or extension cords for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only heard from Oren that the benches and maybe the shed roof are first, but I don’t know who’s bringing what yet. If you find the list, could you let me know—I’d like to help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey—I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I find the list or hear what’s missing. If you can bring anything yourself, tell me and I’ll pass your name to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Vik—about the repair drive, I think folks are starting with the wobbly benches and maybe that leaky shed roof, though I ought to check the list before I swear to it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—please check the list when you can. I’m telling folks to start bringing things by around 10 in the morning so we have time to sort supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds sensible, Vik—I’ll check the list and let you know if I spot any missing tools before folks start arriving around 10.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Leo—sorry, I’m still piecing the repair drive together, but Gus offered tools and a hand, so I think we’re getting somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—Gus can cover tools. Let’s match him first with broken locks, active leaks, or no heat once Rosa’s call list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, that makes sense—locks, leaks, and heat first once Rosa’s list shows up. I’ll try not to lose track and will check with Gus about what tools he can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I’ve already told Noah I’m happy to bring tools and help out—if you hear what repairs folks are bringing, let me know so I can pack the right gear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Gus. I’ll ask around and make a neat list of the repairs, then I’ll let you know what to pack.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Eli—that’ll help a lot. Once you’ve got the list, I’ll sort out the tools and bring the workbench if it looks useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got Faye down for Saturday 10 to noon, helping with check-in or sorting repairs, so we should plan the repair drive around that window.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Mara—I’ll spread the word that Saturday 10 to noon is the key window, and I’ll keep Uli in the loop without leaning on them to join.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — that sounds perfect, and I appreciate you keeping Uli informed without putting pressure on them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Opal! The repair drive’s moving along—Mara’s crew is already sorting tools, and I’m still trying to pin down when Sam’s group can bring extra hands this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—last I had, Sam was checking the community room tables and the east entrance supplies, so let’s wait on that report before we lock in where his group can help this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds wise, Opal—I’ll hold off on giving Nell any firm times until Sam reports back, and I’ll keep Mara’s crew in the loop so we don’t cross wires.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I’m glad you’re here—we’re putting safety issues first for the repair drive, like broken locks, active leaks, and no heat. If you know anyone who should be near the top of the list, tell me and I’ll add them before I start calling around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll check my supply notes and names I’ve heard, and I’ll send you anyone with broken locks, active leaks, or no heat right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Cleo—send me whatever you have, even if it’s just a partial note, and I’ll fold it into the priority list before calls this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I’m still piecing things together from what folks have told me—have you heard any confirmed times for Sam’s group joining the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, Nell—do you have a direct way to reach Sam? I need a firm time and names tonight, along with who’s bringing drills, ladders, and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have Sam’s direct contact, unfortunately—I’d rather not guess, but I can check back with Jules since they were trying to connect Sam’s group with Mara’s crew.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, since neither of us has confirmed details yet, let’s start by writing down only what we know for sure: repair needs, locations, and any volunteers who’ve actually committed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good plan, Hana. I’ll mark a clean list for confirmed repairs, locations, and committed volunteers, and leave anything uncertain off until someone verifies it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. Let’s also note who verified each item, so we know what’s solid and what still needs checking.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around for the coordinator first, Pia, and I won’t give my block a start time until we know it’s solid.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that sounds like the safest plan. Let me know once you find out, and I’ll help spread the word accurately.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Pia — I’ll check with a couple folks this afternoon and come back to you before I tell anyone anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, quick check—do you know if the repair drive is actually confirmed, and who’s organizing it? I promised Kira I’d verify before spreading it around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve been coordinating with Mara, and the plan I heard was Saturday 10 to noon, but I’d check with her before you spread it as fully confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—thanks, Faye. I’ll check with Mara directly before I tell Kira anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Kira, I’m just about to check which repair tables are set up in the community room, then I’ll look at the supplies by the east entrance.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam—before I tell anyone, can you confirm who’s organizing the repair drive and that those tables are officially part of it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Opal’s the one coordinating the repair drive from what I know, but I’ll confirm the tables are officially part of it when I check the community room.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
